{"version": 1, "tone": "icon", "look": "card", "step": 1, "icon": "flag", "text": "### Sets and stories

One **Run** makes a set of images from one loop. Three ways to run it, one row each; **WP Toggles · pick a mode** (below) switches the other two off. Each row reads left to right: **Lists**, **Prompt**, **Image**, **Pick and grid**.

| Mode | What changes from frame to frame |
|---|---|
| **Every frame different** | everything: a new person, outfit, place and light |
| **Photo shoot** | pose, expression and the camera. Same person, outfit, place, light |
| **Storyboard** | the story's next beat: what happens, where, the light, the shot |

:pi-images: Each run **pauses** at **WP Image Filter**: look the frames over, click the ones you want, then **Continue**. Only the picks go on the Label & Grid sheet (Keep all, or wait 10 minutes, keeps them all). [WP Image Filter](docs:wp-image-filter){button pi-filter}

All the lists come with this workflow, in packs (bundles) on the **WP Context** nodes.

[Add this workflow's lists to my library](wp:library){button pi-download}

| Key | Jump to |
|---|---|
| `1` | Every frame different |
| `2` | Photo shoot |
| `3` | Storyboard |

:pi-bookmark: Press a step's number key with the canvas focused, or click it in the **Bookmarks** dock (top bar). **Start here** is a bookmark too, so the dock always brings you back to this note.

:pi-question-circle:{#6366f1} **Help for any node:** select it and press the indigo **?** in the toolbar above it. Its help page opens over the canvas, with what every socket and control does. On WP Toggles, Note and Bookmark the **pencil** next to it opens the editor.

![The node toolbar, with the indigo ? help button](wp:asset/toolbar-help){width=70%}

:pi-lightbulb:{#22c55e} The lists name no style, so they suit any model. **WP Model Info** in each row sets the quality words: Illustrious / NoobAI by default, Pony's score tags, none for Flux. Add your style to the template.

:pi-lock: Want this for your own lists? [Keep something the same](docs:howto-keep-steady){button pi-lock} explains **Hold across run**, the switch the photo shoot and the storyboard lean on.

---
